attributes.body_ja:
五段動詞（ごだんどうし）の「伴（ともな）う」のテ形（けい）と「に」が名詞（めいし）や辞書形（じしょけい）の動詞（どうし）の後（うし）ろに置（お）かれると、「(A) が原因（げんいん）で (B)」や「(A) に連（つ）れて (B)」のような意味（いみ）を表（あらわ）します。この文法（ぶんぽう）の中心（ちゅうしん）には「一緒（いっしょ）に行（い）く」という意味（いみ）があります。

この文法（ぶんぽう）の「一緒（いっしょ）に行（い）く」という意味（いみ）からもわかるように、(A) は (B) をコントロールするものではありません。つまり、「に伴（ともな）って」は、(A) が 直接的（ちょくせつてき）な原因（げんいん）となって (B) が起（お）こるというより、単（たん）に (A) と (B) が同時（どうじ）に起（お）こることを表（あらわ）します。ただし、(A) が (B) の変化（へんか）に強（つよ）い影響（えいきょう）を与（あた）えるというニュアンスは含（ふく）まれています。

「に伴（ともな）って」は「に伴（ともな）う」という形（かたち）でほかの名詞（めいし）に直接（ちょくせつ）結（むす）びつき、その名詞（めいし）を修飾（しゅうしょく）することができます。

「に伴（ともな）って」は並行（へいこう）して起（お）こるゆっくりとした変化（へんか）にも、瞬間的（しゅんかんてき）な出来事（できごと）による突然（とつぜん）の変化（へんか）にも使（つか）うことができます。
attributes.body:
When the う-Verb 伴（ともな）う 'to accompany' in its て-form is used with に and attached to the end of nouns or verbs in their dictionary forms, it is regularly translated as 'due to (A), (B)', 'hand in hand with (A), (B)', or 'along with (A), (B)'. In all of these meanings, the base interpretation of 'to accompany' is being highlighted.

As 'accompanying' does not specifically indicate that (A) is controlling (B), this grammar structure may be used simply to indicate things that happen at the same time, rather than when something is being directly caused by the first. However, (A) having a strong influence on the change of (B) is usually implied.

に伴（ともな）う may also appear directly before another noun when it is being modified by the verb.

に伴（ともな）って is used both for events that are progressively changing at the same time, and momentary events that cause a sudden change.

に沿って and に伴って・に伴い both imply corresponding relationships, but with different nuances. に沿って means in line with in literal or figurative contexts, as in 点線に沿って (along the dotted line) or スケジュールに沿って (in line with the schedule). に伴って・に伴い suggests one change occurring along with another, as in 人口減少に伴って (along with the declining population).

attributes.body: に伴って・に伴い describes changes in one thing due to another, in a proportional or cause-and-effect manner, as in 人口減少に伴って (along with the declining population). にしたがって can overlap in this usage, but it also extends to a broader sense of following rules or standards, as in 指示に従って (according to instructions).

attributes.body: Both can describe one event influencing another, but with very different nuance. きっかけ refers to something that triggered or led to a change, as in 入院をきっかけにタバコをやめた (I gave up smoking on the occasion of my hospitalization). に伴って・に伴い is more formal, often expressing a broader causal relationship, as in 高齢化に伴い人口が激減した (The population rapidly declined along with the aging of the population).

attributes.body: Both に伴って and と並んで connect two elements, but differ in meaning. に伴って expresses a causal or accompanying relationship where one thing changes in response to another, e.g. '経済の成長に伴って、生活水準も上がった' ('As the economy grew, the standard of living also rose'). と並んで indicates comparable qualities without implying cause, e.g. 'ドラえもんと並んで人気のアニメ' ('an anime as popular as Doraemon').

attributes.body: に伴って・に伴い and と共に both express things happening in connection with another event. と共に emphasizes simultaneity or shared experience, e.g. '成長と共に責任も増える' ('Responsibility grows along with maturity'). に伴って・に伴い emphasizes causality or consequential change, often in formal contexts, e.g. '経済の発展に伴って生活水準が向上した' ('As the economy developed, living standards improved').

attributes.body: につれて and に伴って・に伴い both express one thing happening as a result of or alongside another. につれて emphasizes gradual and proportional change, e.g. '年を取るにつれて体力が落ちる' ('As I age, my stamina declines'). に伴って・に伴い can also be used with one-time or habitual events, e.g. '津波は地震に伴い発生する' ('Tsunamis occur together with earthquakes').
